newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates steady on selective trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates steady on selective trade.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates held steady on Sunday amid selective buying by spinners, most of whom were sidelined ahead of Monday's polls, dealers said.

They said lack of transport for physical delivery of cotton kept demand low and only select quality stocks were lifted by spinners. Dealers said candidates had hired many truck to ferry voters to and from polling stations.
In the kerb market, NIAB-78 variety was traded at 2,075 rupees ($51.59) per maund (37.32 kg), he said.
